overview.text: The Green Vine Snake is a very slender, rear-fanged tree snake of Central America and northern South America.

identification.text: Very thin (about 2 cm thick), with a long, delicate tail and a long, very pointed head.

distribution.label: Native
distribution.text: Southern Mexico through Central America to Colombia, Venezuela, the Guianas, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia and Brazil.

behaviour.text: Lives almost only in trees, watching from branches for small animals below.

diet.text: Rodents, lizards, frogs, birds and other small animals, which it follows a short way before striking.

recognise.text: Very long, thin green body and pointed head.
